summary: Vodafone Group filed a Form 6-K containing a routine Stock Exchange announcement of a PDMR shareholding notification under Article 19 MAR. Chief External and Corporate Affairs Officer Joakim Reiter sold 500,000 ordinary shares at 1.26725 pence per share on 18 September 2026, an aggregate GBP 633,625, on the London Stock Exchange. This is an insider dealing disclosure, equivalent to a US Form 4, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, deal mechanics, or regulatory clock applies; watch only for further PDMR disclosures.
